title: Cross-functional roadmap sync prep - Feb 2026 (personal notes)
content:
TL;DR:
- Goal for this sync: align Product + Eng + Applied ML on priority work that affects serving/runtime optimizations, model onboarding cadence, and evaluation/quality metrics for H1 deliverables.
- Main asks from Applied ML: 1) clearer SLA for model quantization tradeoffs, 2) timeline for model freeze/hand-off, 3) acceptance criteria for regressions.

Agenda (30-40m):
1) 5m - Quick status: each area says 1 highlight + 1 blocker
   - Product: shipping hosted pricing update, wants predictable latency targets for premium tier
   - Eng (serving/runtime): kernel updates in staging, need stable model build by Mar 8 to validate performance
   - Applied ML: two models finishing finetune next week, need eval harness and perf targets
2) 10m - Model onboarding cadence and cutover plan
   - Proposed cadence: weekly model drop window Tue 00:00 UTC, + 48h validation window before canary
   - Questions: who signs off on quality? Applied ML + Product (feature owner) + SRE for infra safety
3) 10m - Quantization and performance tradeoffs
   - Applied ML to propose 3 quantization profiles with expected latency/cost delta
   - Need a table mapping profile -> expected p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens, and quality delta on key eval prompts (prompt set url in Confluence)
4) 5-10m - Risk register & rollback plan for canary failures
   - Define automatic fallback thresholds (e.g., hallucination rate, latency > target, error rates)
5) 5m - Action items and owners

Notes / talking points to raise:
- We should unify the acceptance criteria doc so Product and Applied ML don't have different pass thresholds (e.g., mean BLEU vs. human eval fallback). Link: Confluence above.
- Latency SLOs need to be expressed in terms of user scenarios (chat 95th pct, streaming startup latency). Engineering needs p95 baseline from last 2 weeks (ask SRE to surface).
- Cost numbers: we need cost / 1M tokens for each model variant (int8, int4, fp16) to include in the product pricing discussion. Ops will need the dedicated capacity estimate if we expect sustained 5k RPS.
- Canary rollout: suggest staging -> 10% canary (24h) -> 50% (24h) -> 100%. Require rollback on any functional regression flagged by evaluation harness or increase in 5xxs.

Open questions to resolve during sync:
- Who is the final owner for the model acceptance checklist? (Product or Applied ML?)
- Do we consider bundling quantization profiles with model versions in the registry (metadata)? (I think yes - will propose schema change in MR #412).
- Can SRE provide a quick heatmap of the recent tail latencies by region before the sync? If not, we should push_canary timeline by 1 week.

Prep TODOs (my personal):
- [ ] Pull last 2 weeks p95/p99 latency by model and region (ask SRE, due 2026-02-26) - assigned to Sam
- [ ] Draft short acceptance checklist and share with Asha/Product (due 2026-02-27) - Sam
- [ ] Add quantization profile table stub to Confluence + link to eval prompts (due 2026-02-27) - Maya to fill numbers, Sam to verify
- [ ] Add canary rollback thresholds to rollout doc (due 2026-03-01) - John to update

Follow-ups (post-sync expected):
- Applied ML to publish evaluation results for 3 quant profiles (target 2026-03-03)
- Product to confirm pricing sensitivity for ~10% margin change (target 2026-03-05)
- Eng to get staging kernel changes validated with the frozen model build (target 2026-03-08)

Risks / notes for execs (short):
- If we push too aggressively on int4 without robust eval, we risk regression in customer-facing quality; recommend we limit int4 to internal beta for 2 weeks.
- Dedicated capacity planning note: projected 2-3x peak GPU hours for model A if adopted by enterprise tier - need finance review.

Helper links (to paste in chat during sync):
- Eval prompt set: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ML/Eval+prompt+sets
- Model registry MR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-registry/pull/412
- Rollout playbook (draft): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Rollout+playbook+v2

Quick list of action items to capture at end of meeting (copy to notes):
- Owner: Applied ML (Maya) - publish eval table for 3 quant profiles by 2026-03-03
- Owner: Product (Asha) - confirm pricing sensitivity and communicate acceptable cost delta by 2026-03-05
- Owner: Eng (John) - validate kernel changes with frozen build and post perf numbers by 2026-03-08
- Owner: Sam - consolidate latency/cost numbers and update acceptance checklist by 2026-02-27

Personal quick notes / scratch:
- Keep convo focused: quality guardrails first, then performance/cost. If Product insists on aggressive cost targets, push for internal beta only.
- If SRE can't produce region heatmap quickly, escalate to Lina (SRE lead) - we can't canary blind.
- Remember to call out the github MR for registry metadata (helps Applied ML track profiles per version).

End of notes.
